issue.title: Fork CI reconciler: count a workflow added by a PR as project CI only if its jobs did work
issue.body:
The fork CI reconciler (AIP-120, #74822) decides that a project CI run "bypassed the gate" when the base branch's copy of the run's workflow is not triggered by the run's event. A workflow the pull request adds therefore always counts, even if all of its jobs were skipped in `apache/airflow` (for example a fork-only workflow guarded by `if: github.repository != 'apache/airflow'`). If the pull request also changes `.github/workflows/`, which adding the file does, it is closed for gate tampering although no project CI work ran.

Proposed: for workflows the base branch does not trigger, list the run's jobs as is already done for long `ci-amd.yml` runs, and count the run only if a job ran. Keep failing closed when the job list cannot be read.

Code: `BypassFinder._did_run_project_ci` in `dev/breeze/src/airflow_breeze/utils/fork_ci_reconcile.py`.
